Great Question | Product Engineer | Remote (Canada) | Full-time | https://greatquestion.com

Great Question is the best way to understand your customers - whether it's mining what they've already told you, or generating new research via interviews, surveys and prototype tests. We're 2nd time founders, closed our Series A last year, with customers from Canva & Brex to Intuit & Amazon.

We're hiring product engineers to help us push the envelope on what's possible in AI engineering practices, while helping our customers bake customer insight into every product release.

You'll do well here if you have a strong sense of what makes a quality product, you're AI native, and you solve the problem of ambiguity with getting closer to customers.

We're hiring product engineers!
